purpose: Prevent attractive legacy themes from re-entering M3 as weak shopping lists or cosmetic kill quests. A deferred concept may return only when both its player decision and exact SPT 4.1.5 observability are stronger than the admitted campaign alternative.

referenceBoundary.publicQuestDocumentation: sp-tarkov/wiki quest-values.md is useful design evidence but is not exact SPT 4.1.5 runtime authority

concepts.historicalIntent: Trauma basics -> sustained field treatment -> advanced medical readiness.
concepts.reason: The product fantasy is treating injuries under operational pressure. A FindItem/HandoverItem substitute proves shopping, not treatment skill, and would overlap Forward Reserve's logistics language. Current public quest-condition references do not establish a player-treatment event condition that can honestly observe bleeding control, surgery or pain treatment as the defining task.
admissionRequirements: Exact SPT 4.1.5 proves a native, reliable player medical-state/treatment condition or equivalent observable event.
The operation can be completed through actual treatment behavior rather than by handing over a list of medical items.
The objective is semantically distinct from current vanilla medical quests and approved external content.
Any medical sample reward passes Economy Admiral review and remains one-time or tightly finite.
concepts.forbiddenFallback: Do not create AI-2/AFAK/CMS/etc. collection ladders and label them medical proficiency.

concepts.historicalIntent: Controlled stimulant familiarization -> high-risk chemical support.
concepts.reason: The interesting decision is using a stimulant for a specific operational need. A stim handover is only procurement, while a generic kill quest with a story about stimulants is dishonest unless the condition can prove the relevant player state. Renewable high-value stimulant rewards also create disproportionate economy risk.
admissionRequirements: Exact SPT 4.1.5 proves the required player-state/effect condition for the intended operation.
The chosen effect changes a real tactical decision rather than merely being consumed before an ordinary kill counter.
Economy Admiral approves any one-time sample and explicitly rejects renewable faucet behavior.
No vanilla or approved external quest already expresses the same stimulant-use problem.
concepts.forbiddenFallback: Do not convert Stims Proficiency into per-stim handovers or a stimulant storefront ladder.

concepts.reason: Survive once on several maps is still a checklist whose only meaningful variable is location. It reduces the old x2/x5/x10 ladder but does not yet create a new decision.
rewriteDirections: Prefer one distinctive withdrawal/exfil problem using a meaningful native ExitName/ExitStatus combination if exact SPT 4.1.5 data and overlap support it.
A route/transit operation may be stronger than independent map counters if native transit semantics are exact and reliable.
Do not require three maps merely to make the quest feel longer.
concepts.forbiddenFallback: No survive-N-raids or one-extract-per-map checklist without a distinct operational constraint.

concepts.historicalIntent: One deliberate high-value-target operation instead of escalating boss counters.
concepts.reason: A named boss kill is mechanically straightforward but easily becomes a cosmetic duplicate of existing vanilla boss objectives. It should enter Admiral only if external-content absorption supplies a stronger operational setup or a target-specific consequence that survives semantic-overlap review.
admissionRequirements: Target-specific Why/Context/Payoff that cannot be removed without changing the quest's player decision.
Exact SPT 4.1.5 role alias and map availability proof.
No semantic duplicate in current vanilla, Admiral or approved external content.
No boss-equipment faucet or guaranteed high-tier gear reward.
concepts.forbiddenFallback: Do not publish kill Glukhar/Killa/etc. once simply because the old bundle existed.

concepts.historicalIntent: Night special operation rather than a 1-to-75 cultist elimination ladder.
concepts.reason: A cultist role plus night-time kill condition is mechanically plausible in current public documentation, but that alone can still duplicate vanilla night/cultist content. Exact SPT 4.1.5 role/time semantics and current overlap must be proven before the theme earns an Admiral slot.
admissionRequirements: Exact SPT 4.1.5 proves the intended sectant role alias and Kills daytime semantics.
The operation has a target-specific purpose beyond 'cultists are dangerous at night'.
Current vanilla and approved external overlap review finds a genuinely distinct operation.
Target count remains small and non-escalating.
concepts.forbiddenFallback: No cultist body-count ladder and no rare night-gear faucet.
